summary: Admin accounts use each tenant's own domain, and the engine now follows your naming conventions.

new.title: Admin account domain per tenant
new.text: Settings > Admin account domain lists this tenant's verified domains. Admins replicated to a managed tenant use that tenant's own domain.

new.title: Wizards show replication on managed tenants
new.text: On a managed tenant, each create wizard notes that the row is local to this tenant and not replicated.

fixes.title: The engine follows your naming
fixes.text: Naming set in Settings was shown in PIM Manager but not used by the engine. The engine now uses the same settings.

fixes.title: Imported v1 admins are recognised
fixes.text: Memberships of imported v1 admins were refused as not defined and blocked Commit. They are now matched correctly.

fixes.title: Revoke works for any Entra role assignment
fixes.text: Revoking an Entra role assigned outside PIM used to fail. Revoke now checks how the role is held and removes it the right way, or explains why not.
